questions.question_text:
The word 'decoding' in the process of communication refers to ________
(A) Comprehending
(B) Speaking
(C) Listening
(D) Reading
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: Decoding is the process of interpreting and comprehending the sender's message.

questions.question_text:
A type of communication that occurs between a human being and a non-human entity is ________
(A) Interpersonal communication
(B) Intrapersonal communication
(C) Extrapersonal communication
(D) Diagonal communication
questions.answer:
(C)
Explanation: Extrapersonal communication involves interaction between human beings and non-human entities (like animals, machines, or nature).

questions.question_text:
Attitude barriers can be minimized through ________ sessions.
(A) Counselling
(B) listening
(C) drawing
(D) writing
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: Counselling sessions help address and minimize personal and attitude-related barriers to communication.

questions.question_text:
Technical communication is effective only when you are addressing ________
(A) Enthusiastic commoners
(B) Patient public
(C) Technically aware audience
(D) Empathetic listeners
questions.answer:
(C)
Explanation: Technical communication uses specialized terminology and concepts that require a technically aware audience to be fully effective.
questions.chapter: Unit 2 - English: The Language of Science & Technology

questions.question_text:
Checklist is a ________
(A) List of things to be checked or done
(B) List of instructions
(C) List of likes
(D) List of dislikes
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: A checklist is fundamentally a list of items required, things to be done, or points to be considered.
questions.chapter: Unit 2 - English: The Language of Science & Technology

questions.question_text:
________ is a diagrammatic representation of a step by step process.
(A) Tables
(B) Pie chart
(C) Flow chart
(D) Organogram
questions.answer:
(C)
Explanation: A flowchart visually maps out the sequence of steps and decisions in a process.
questions.chapter: Unit 2 - English: The Language of Science & Technology

questions.question_text:
Which of the following in an example for synchronous communication?
(A) Video chatting
(B) Reading comments
(C) Responding to emails
(D) Texting messages
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: Synchronous communication happens in real-time, such as during a live video chat.

questions.question_text:
Submitting a work via Google Classroom that will be viewed and graded tomorrow is an example of ________.
(A) Synchronous communication
(B) Asynchronous communication
(C) Traditional communication
(D) Theoretical communication
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: Sending information that will be read and responded to at a later time is asynchronous communication.

questions.question_text:
Netiquette is a shortened form of ________
(A) Network education terminology
(B) Internet inequities
(C) Internet etiquette
(D) Necessary teaching etiquette
questions.answer:
(C)
Explanation: Netiquette is a portmanteau of the words 'Internet' and 'etiquette'.

questions.question_text:
Following Netiquettes will help you to ________
(A) Get along better with your friends
(B) Avoid offensive online behavior
(C) Navigate the Internet
(D) Do better on exams
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: Netiquette guidelines promote respectful interactions and help users avoid offensive or inappropriate behavior online.

questions.question_text:
What should you focus on during the interview?
(A) The salary you want
(B) Vacation you want
(C) Your contribution to the company
(D) Working hours
questions.answer:
(C)
Explanation: During an interview, focusing on the value and contributions you can bring to the company highlights your professional merit.

questions.question_text:
Which of the following is NOT an opening line of a response letter?
(A) I am writing to you in relation to...
(B) Further to our earlier exchange...
(C) Thank you for contacting us...
(D) We recently wrote to you about...
questions.answer:
(D)
Explanation: 'We recently wrote to you about...' is typically used for a follow-up or an initiating letter, rather than a direct response to a client's inquiry.

questions.question_text:
The quality of the mangoes ________ not good.
(A) Are
(B) Is
(C) Have
(D) Has
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: The subject 'quality' is singular, so it takes the singular verb 'is'.

questions.question_text:
Minutes of the meeting refers to ________
(A) Record of the discussion of the meeting
(B) Points to be discussed in the meeting
(C) List of participants of the meeting
(D) Time of the meeting
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: Meeting minutes are the official written record of the discussions held and decisions made during a meeting.
